files.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-18. The visible calendar needs JavaScript, but all events are embedded in the page as a JavaScript array (json = [[id, ?, start YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS, end, all_day, title, ...]]), so it is parseable without a browser. 22 events, all dated 29 Sep to 19 Dec 2025 (the calendar had not been updated for 2026/27 at capture time). Titles contain no personal names. Redacted the school office email and phone (footer text and mailto/tel attributes) because the guard test allows only placeholders.
